Are you ready for a new challenge in logistics? At AS Watson in Oosterhout, we are looking for enthusiastic new colleagues. Are you looking for a varied job where you can stay active, work in a friendly team, and have opportunities to grow? Then this part time Order Picker position could be perfect for you!Together with your colleagues, you make sure that all orders are picked carefully, processed on time, and prepared for shipment. You will use a voicepicking system, available in Dutch, English, and Polish that guides you through the warehouse step by step. You will pick a wide variety of products, from soft drinks and shampoo to toys and cleaning products. Using your pallet-building skills, you make sure every pallet is stacked carefull and correctly, so our stores receive everything they need!- You are motivated and a hard worker- You are available to work in a two shift system: 06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00.- You enjoy working as part of a team.- You work accurately and have an eye for quality.- You are available on Saturdays.- You have your own transportation, such as a car or bicycle.- You have a sufficient command of the English language to understand work instructions and communicate with your colleagues.

Logistics Project Manager – Demand Planning This role of Logistics Project Manager – Demand Planner position calls for a confident and decisive professional who is comfortable questioning assumptions, making data-driven decisions, and engaging proactively with both customers and internal stakeholders in a fast-moving production environment. Responsibilities As a Logistics Project Manager – Demand Planner, you play a key role in strengthening the supply chain performance. You are responsible for creating and maintaining a reliable global demand plan that balances customer requirements with manufacturing capabilities. Working at the intersection of data analysis, operations, and customer communication, you help ensure excellent delivery performance, effective inventory management, and an efficient production flow. What will you do? Take ownership of the global demand planning process and continuously improve its effectiveness within a dynamic manufacturing environment. Analyse historical sales data, forecasts, and market developments, translating insights into accurate and actionable demand plans. Serve as a trusted business partner for Production, Procurement, Project Management, Account Management, and Logistics. Work directly with customers to align expectations and effectively manage fluctuations in demand. Identify supply chain risks and bottlenecks and take timely action to minimise their impact. Lead continuous improvement initiatives and critically evaluate existing processes to enhance overall performance. Arbeidsvoorwaarden 25 paid holidays (excluding national public holidays) Flexible working hours Complimentary access to the company gym · Free lunch, dinner, and healthy snacks available on-site every day Wat levert deze baan jou op? A strong commitment to personal development through an individual learning and growth plan Extensive opportunities to develop your career across a wide variety of functions and project What do you bring? A Master's degree inSupply Chain, Business, or a related discipline. At least 7 years of experience in demand planning, supply chain planning, or forecasting within a manufacturing environment. Excellent analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and Business Intelligence tools. Demonstrated experience working with Lean, Kaizen, or other continuous improvement methodologies. A confident and proactive mindset, with the ability to challenge, influence, and drive decision-making. Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working directly with customers. The ability to combine analytical depth with a practical, end-to-end business perspective. Fluency in English. Hier kom je te werken At our client’s, they design and manufacture cutting-edge technology that powers industries and connects the world. With over 500 unique products across various domains, they’re dedicated to making the world work smarter and more sustainably.

Are you looking for a warehouse job with different tasks and opportunities to learn? At DHL Supply Chain in Weert, you will work in the Re-Use department, where you handle special technical parts.In this department, you work with valuable parts that are used in high-tech machines. You make sure that all parts are received, checked, processed and prepared for their next step.Your work is varied, so no day is exactly the same. Your tasks may include receiving and checking goods, scanning products, checking parts for quality, sorting materials, picking orders and preparing shipments.Accuracy is very important because you work with valuable and sensitive products. Together with your colleagues, you make sure everything is processed correctly.You do not need previous warehouse experience. If you are motivated, careful and willing to learn, there are opportunities to develop yourself within the department.- You speak and understand English well;- You are available to work 40 hours per week;- You are looking for a dayshift warehouse job;- You are motivated and reliable;- You work carefully and pay attention to detail;- Warehouse experience is a plus, but not required.

We are looking for young film critics! Cinekid is looking for English-speaking children between 4 - 14 years to join 'Ask Your Audience' in smaller focus groups. We are looking for young film critics! During Cinekid for Professionals this October, international filmmakers get the opportunity to present their new projects to the most important audience: kids themselves. 'Ask Your Audience' is a unique opportunity for children who love storytelling and movies, to have a real impact on the films and shows they will be watching in the future.  Who are we looking for? We are looking for English-speaking children or school groups between the ages 4 to 14. They will be joining smaller focus groups, depending on their age. After a quick presentation by selected filmmakers, kids will have the opportunity to ask questions about anything related to the project as well as share their opinions. A moderator will guide the sessions, to support a valuable exchange between the filmmakers and their young critics.  When and where will it happen? Ask Your Audience will take place during Cinekid Festival at Pathé Amsterdam Noord on 21, 22 and 23 October . Children will join us for 1 - 2 hours, depending on their age. We will share a more detailed schedule closer to the event.  What can we offer? To thank the children for their feedback, we can offer them the full Cinekid Festival experience; a complementary ticket for a festival screening and access to the MediaLab.  How can you apply? If your child is interested in participating or you would like to get more information about the programme, please contact us at professionals@cinekid.nl with the subject 'Ask Your Audience 2025'. Please include the age of your child and sign up before 24 September.

jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver/ Operator Bottelarij | 5 Shifts | Bavaria (124115002)
jobs.description: As a Forklift Driver and Operator at Bavaria's Bottling Department, you have the opportunity to make a direct impact. You ensure that the logistics process runs smoothly, so our beers can reach customers around the world on time and in excellent quality. Do you enjoy variety, taking responsibility and working as part of a team? Then this is the perfect job for you!Your responsibilities:- You use your forklift to transport empty cans to the production line, making sure your colleagues always have the supplies they need.- You keep your work area clean and safe, and step in to support the production process as an operator on our modern production line.- Every day is different: one day you are driving the forklift, the next you are directly involved in the production process.- You work in a friendly team, and together you make sure everything runs smoothly!Working hours & shift schedule:Until December 2026, you will work in a 3-shift rotation:- Week 1: 4–5 night shifts (22:00–06:00)- Week 2: 3 afternoon shifts (14:00–22:00) and 2 morning shifts (06:00–14:00)- Week 3: 3 morning shifts (06:00–14:00) and 2 afternoon shifts (14:00–22:00)From January 2027 onwards, you will switch to a dynamic 5-shift rotation:- 2 morning shifts (06:00–14:00)- 2 afternoon shifts (14:00–22:00)- 2 night shifts (22:00–06:00)After these six shifts, you will have 4 days off, giving you plenty of time to relax and recharge!- You have a forklift certificate or are willing to get one. - You speak Dutch or English- You don’t mind working in shifts. - You live within 40 kilometers of Lieshout.
